meta.race: Fall Athletic Cut — Sep 14 – Nov 8, 2026. Athleticism and fat loss (260 → sub-250). Not a strength block.

calf_rules: The calf gate governs ALL impact — running, jumping, and change-of-direction. Log a calf rating after every run or jump session.
Anything above 2/10 freezes the impact ramp at its current stage — repeat, do not advance.
A flare steps the ramp back one stage.
Weeks 1–3 are the running test protocol: zero impact elsewhere, engine on the rower. Run test 2 read 3/10 on 9/21, so Stage 1 repeats in Week 3 — ≤2/10 on that repeat unlocks Stage 2 in Week 4.

Running ramp (shifted one week after the 9/21 calf 3/10): Stage 1 (W1–3) walk/jog intervals, 15–16 min, easy · Stage 2 (W4–5) continuous easy jog then 2:1 jog/walk intervals · Deload (W6) easy continuous only · Stage 3 (W7) push/base tread intervals · Stage 4 (W8) benchmark run — Stage 4 protocol only if Week 7 came through ≤2/10, otherwise benchmark at the Stage 3 protocol and note it.
